evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete pdata/chained windows of the anonymous optimized reader and metadata-named BeyondReadString, plus the shared lookup helper.
evidenceBoundary.direct: On the pool-present branch, both consume an Int32 index, return the same empty-string literal for -1 and null for -2, and tail-forward the remaining index and identical pool instance to the same lookup helper.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Selected initialized pool-present branch, compatible reader and pool, sufficient buffered index bytes and normal helpers. Pool-absent behavior and live pool selection are not admitted.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: This proves a string-valued read, not inline MemoryPack string wire compatibility or current corpus admission.

forwarding.selection: normal initialization calls preserve saved reader/output and valid matched frame; default concrete formatter selected

listRegistration.boundary: Selected registration and physical entry only; runtime closed type, MethodInfo selection and instantiated fields unproved.

header.condition: buffered normal path; valid stable disjoint source/output/reader/frame; pointer and signed counters do not overflow; sufficient total budget

readString.condition: authenticated collection header; initialized empty literal; normal ABI-preserving initialization calls

readUtf8.condition: nonnegative buffered byte count; authenticated typed span/context; normal ABI-preserving disjoint callees; selected encoding and decoder semantics proved independently

span.condition: typed ReadOnlySpan<byte> context proved independently; valid disjoint 16-byte output; normal ABI-preserving class initialization

spanString.condition: positive stable span; normal ABI-preserving class initialization; pointer overload decoding semantics proved independently

advance.condition: nonnegative buffered count; valid reader/frame; pointer and signed counter arithmetic do not overflow

constructor.condition: ordinary named UTF8Encoding(bool,bool) ABI and typed fields authenticated; normal initializer preserves saved arguments, object and disjoint frame; constructor called on valid zero-initialized allocation

cache.condition: authenticated Encoding static cache and UTF8Encoding allocation cells; cache is initially null or holds the corresponding initialized UTF8 encoding; valid zeroed allocation; normal ABI-preserving disjoint allocator/initializer/barrier; no interfering cache or object mutation

pointer.condition: valid stable nonnull encoding/byte source and nonnegative count; normal prepare/allocator/decoder callees preserve ABI and disjoint frames; allocation yields a valid String of the requested character capacity; virtual methods and decoder character semantics proved independently

virtualPrefix.condition: actual receiver class function at the requested slot equals the authenticated selected method, hence none of the optimized targets; normal class preparation and call ABI; complete helper effects and other paths unproved

evidenceBoundary.direct: Typed four-member Param and selected reference ReadPackable clone, owned fields/factory/null parent, two Int32 bindings and pooled path; concrete ListFormatter<T> consumes the signed null collection header and writes a null List reference.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Initialized coherent closed contexts and matching normal generated Param wrapper and ListFormatter<T> route; sufficient contiguous input, disjoint storage and ordinary helper/allocation/barrier ABI.
unresolved: every nonnull list count and element
